description: An ornate Moroccan room with a carved dark wood low table holding an unrolled cream parchment scroll, a brass inkwell with a quill, and a red wax seal. A black peaked cap with gold braid and brown leather gloves rest on the table, and an embroidered cushion sits on a bench behind it. Zellige tiles line the walls, carved wooden doors stand in the background, and the floor is patterned tile. No people are visible, and the scroll shows no legible writing. The style is an oil painting that fills the frame edge to edge.
